questions.question: When was the colonoscopy referral first made, and what was the clinical indication?
Has the patient reported any gastrointestinal symptoms such as bleeding, change in bowel habit, or abdominal pain that prompted the colonoscopy referral?
Was a specific colonoscopy indication (e.g., iron deficiency anaemia, positive FOBT, surveillance) documented, and when?
Have any relevant investigations (e.g., FBC, ferritin, CRP, calprotectin, imaging) been performed, and what were the results?
Was there a documented discussion with the patient about colonoscopy risks, benefits and alternatives, and when did it occur?
Has the patient been assessed for anticoagulant or antiplatelet use that may affect colonoscopy planning?
